_note: APPROXIMATE PLANNING ESTIMATES. Unit costs are indicative Indian 2026 price levels (INR) compiled for demonstration; replace with municipal schedule-of-rates values for real planning. Cooling values are expected reductions of the analysis-cell mean LST and follow simple linear coverage models documented in docs/METHODOLOGY.md.

tree_plantation.name: Tree Plantation
tree_plantation.unit_cost_basis: sapling (2-3 m), tree guard, planting and 3-year maintenance per tree
tree_plantation.description: Avenue, street and setback tree planting with native shade species (Neem, Peepal, Karanj, Jamun).

urban_forest.name: Urban Forest Development
urban_forest.unit_cost_basis: Miyawaki-style dense native afforestation incl. soil preparation, saplings and 3-year maintenance
urban_forest.description: Dense multi-layer native forest patches on vacant, barren or fallow land.

cool_roofs.name: Cool Roofs
cool_roofs.unit_cost_basis: solar-reflective white elastomeric / lime-based roof coating applied to existing roofs
cool_roofs.description: High-albedo reflective coatings on residential, commercial and industrial roofs.

cool_pavements.name: Cool Pavements
cool_pavements.unit_cost_basis: reflective / permeable pavement coating or interlocking light-coloured pavers
cool_pavements.description: Reflective or permeable pavements for roads, parking lots and market yards.

water_bodies.name: Water Bodies
water_bodies.unit_cost_basis: retention pond / rejuvenated tank incl. excavation, lining, inlet and landscaping
water_bodies.description: New retention ponds or rejuvenation of dried tanks providing evaporative cooling.
